lessons.title: Trade Thesis
lessons.description: Build a conditional trade plan from context, setup, trigger, invalidation, target, and no-trade conditions.

lessons.title: Support and Resistance
lessons.description: Place support and resistance zones, classify reactions, and distinguish rejection from acceptance and role reversal.

lessons.title: Confluence
lessons.description: Evaluate setup quality using independent evidence from context, location, trigger, participation, and relative performance.

lessons.title: Breakout Setups
lessons.description: Replay confirmed, retested, failed, and crowded breakouts and evaluate entry, wait, or no-trade decisions.

lessons.title: Pullback Setups
lessons.description: Explore pullback depth, structural validity, reaction evidence, and local structure shifts for bullish and bearish setups.

lessons.title: Reversal Setups
lessons.description: Advance through trend maturity, reaction, structure break, retest, and continuation to evaluate reversal candidates.

lessons.title: Entry Confirmation
lessons.description: Compare reaction, structure-shift, and retest entry models and select the first candle that satisfies each rule.

lessons.title: Stop-Loss Placement
lessons.description: Drag a stop line around structural invalidation, assess volatility room, and see how distance changes illustrative position size.

lessons.title: Profit Targets
lessons.description: Place structural targets, compare R multiples, and evaluate single-target, scale-out, and trailing-remainder plans.

lessons.title: Risk-to-Reward
lessons.description: Calculate risk, reward, break-even win rate, and expectancy for adjustable long and short trade plans.

lessons.title: Position Sizing
lessons.description: Calculate maximum share and long-option quantities from equity, risk percentage, stop distance, premium loss, and costs.

lessons.title: Trade Management
lessons.description: Simulate candle-by-candle holding, scaling, break-even stops, trailing, and exits while scoring adherence to a predefined plan.

lessons.title: Backtesting
lessons.description: Generate synthetic trade samples, inspect equity, drawdown, distributions, and compare in-sample with out-of-sample results.

lessons.title: Trading Journal
lessons.description: Create, edit, store, import, and export structured trade journal entries with R outcomes, adherence, execution scores, and mistake tags.

lessons.title: Performance Review
lessons.description: Import journal data, filter and segment performance, compare adherence, diagnose recurring mistakes, and generate one measurable improvement rule.
